kindLine: Chip house, electro and hip hop kits
madeLine: Construction kits in chip house, electro and hip hop, every sound played on models of two 1980s home-computer sound chips, register by register, and written the way the old chip tunes were written: one hook, fast arpeggios, jumping bass. Each kit is a full mix with separate stems and MIDI, plus one-shots to play the chips yourself.
name: 8-Bit Orchestral
summary: The sound of an 80s home computer turned into a producer's toolkit: square-wave hooks, arpeggios at up to 50 notes a second, buzzy and walking basses and chip drums, with strings, brass, choir, harp and guitar voices built from the same chips. Every kit comes as the full mix and as separate stems with MIDI, so you can keep the hook and write your own track around it. Nothing is smoothed over: no limiter, the chips keep their peaks.
